resources.string: Desktop and phone sync

Manually exchange encrypted fingerprint settings and proxies with the same password. Existing IDs stay local by default; deletions do not propagate. Fingerprint behavior differs across engines. Cookies are separately optional snapshots, excluding localStorage, IndexedDB and full login state.

Enter a full file URL in an existing directory. Manual snapshots use separate filenames per device; automatic sync uses the same new shared file. Presigned mode uses GET / PUT URLs; native S3 keys go below. LAN uses the temporary desktop URL. Manual exchanges do not save connections; Save automatic settings encrypts credentials locally.
